name: shadow-island-pc
description: An iPhone-style Dynamic Island for Windows
author: Dynamic Island PC

scripts.bridge:build: python -m PyInstaller --onefile --noconsole --name media-bridge --hidden-import winrt.windows.media.control --hidden-import winrt.windows.storage.streams --distpath bridge/dist --workpath .pybuild/media --specpath .pybuild/media bridge/media_bridge.py && python -m PyInstaller --onefile --noconsole --name volume-bridge --hidden-import pycaw.pycaw --hidden-import comtypes --hidden-import comtypes.client --hidden-import comtypes.automation --distpath bridge/dist --workpath .pybuild/volume --specpath .pybuild/volume bridge/volume_bridge.py && python -m PyInstaller --onefile --noconsole --name system-bridge --distpath bridge/dist --workpath .pybuild/system --specpath .pybuild/system bridge/system_bridge.py
